dedupeText: west coast urban collage aesthetic chicano art style lowrider culture urban collage west coast rap graffiti lettering vector portrait large foreground portrait anchored to the right side secondary character and vehicle balanced on the lower left circular graphic emblem in the upper left corner horizontal text banner grounding the bottom edge combine a high contrast vector portrait with lowrider iconography and blackletter typography to create a classic west coast urban aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered urban collage featuring a central vector-style portrait, a secondary illustrated figure, and a lowrider vehicle set against a stylized city backdrop with heavy graphic emblems and high-contrast typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Large foreground portrait anchored to the right side
Secondary character and vehicle balanced on the lower left
Circular graphic emblem in the upper left corner
Horizontal text banner grounding the bottom edge
coreInvariants: Heavy black outlines on all illustrated elements
Airbrushed-style gradients for skin tones and clothing
Deep blue, forest green, and white color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary male figure dominates the right two-thirds of the frame at a medium-close-up scale; secondary female figure and car occupy the lower left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central male figure's face and blue baseball cap serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central face to the circular emblem at top-left, down to the car and female figure, and finally across the bottom text banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with overlapping elements and background textures.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Forest Green and Dark Purple (background layers)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright White (text, highlights, and clothing panels)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues and greens contrasted against stark white and deep black shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary urban colors: blue, green, black, white

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with sharp, thorn-like serifs
Thick white outlines or 'glow' effects to separate from dark backgrounds
High-contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters featuring exaggerated flourishes and internal decorative lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact decorative blackletter for the brand name paired with a cleaner, more legible script for the subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the traditional West Coast blackletter aesthetic
Standard for the 'Ese' culture visual language

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a digital collage featuring a vector-style portrait of a man in a blue baseball cap and jacket on the right. On the left, include a stylized illustration of a woman leaning against a lime green lowrider car. The background should feature a dark purple sky, green hills, and silhouetted palm trees. Include a circular green and brown emblem in the top left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom blackletter typography inside the top-left emblem and a horizontal line of Old English script across the bottom center. Apply a soft blue outer glow to the bottom text and a heavy black outline to the top text.

verificationChecks: Is the main portrait rendered in a clean vector style?
Does the bottom text have a visible outer glow?
Is the color palette dominated by blue, green, and white?
Are the palm tree silhouettes visible in the background?

postGenerationChecks: Check for sharp edges on all vector elements
Ensure text is legible against the background
Verify the balance between the left and right sides of the collage
Confirm the 'glow' effect on the bottom text is subtle but present
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast vector portrait with lowrider iconography and blackletter typography to create a classic West Coast urban aesthetic.
